par.description: The Pokémon is paralyzed. Its Speed is reduced by 50%, and it has a 25% chance of being unable to move each turn.

brn.description: The Pokémon is burned. Its Attack is reduced by 50% for physical moves, and it takes damage equal to 1/16 of its maximum HP at the end of each turn.

slp.description: The Pokémon is asleep and unable to move. It wakes up after 1 to 3 turns.

psn.description: The Pokémon is poisoned. It takes damage equal to 1/8 of its maximum HP at the end of each turn.

tox.description: The Pokémon is badly poisoned. It takes damage starting at 1/16 of its maximum HP, increasing by an additional 1/16 at the end of each turn.

frz.description: The Pokémon is frozen solid and unable to move. It has a 20% chance to thaw out each turn.

rainweather.description: Rain falls on the battlefield. Water-type moves deal 50% more damage, and Fire-type moves deal 50% less damage.

heavyrainweather.description: Heavy rain pours over the battlefield. Fire-type attacks fail entirely, Water-type moves deal 50% more damage, and other weather conditions cannot be activated.

harshsunlight.description: The sunlight turns harsh on the battlefield. Fire-type moves deal 50% more damage, and Water-type moves deal 50% less damage.

extremelyharshsunlight.description: Extremely harsh sunlight blazes over the battlefield. Water-type attacks fail entirely, Fire-type moves deal 50% more damage, and other weather conditions cannot be activated.

sandstormweather.description: A sandstorm rages across the battlefield. It inflicts damage equal to 1/16 of maximum HP to non-Rock, Ground, or Steel-type Pokémon at the end of each turn, and boosts the Special Defense of Rock-type Pokémon by 50%.

hailweather.description: A hailstorm rages across the battlefield. It inflicts damage equal to 1/16 of maximum HP to non-Ice-type Pokémon at the end of each turn.

snowweather.description: Snow falls on the battlefield. It boosts the Defense of Ice-type Pokémon by 50%.

strongwinds.description: Mysterious strong winds blow across the battlefield. Moves that are normally super effective against Flying-type Pokémon deal neutral damage instead, and other weather conditions cannot be activated.

confusion.description: The Pokémon is confused for 1 to 4 turns. It has a 33% chance each turn to hurt itself instead of executing its move.

flinch.description: The Pokémon flinches in shock. It is unable to move for the remainder of the current turn.

trapped.description: The Pokémon is trapped. It cannot switch out or flee from battle.

partiallytrapped.description: The Pokémon is trapped by a binding move for 4 to 5 turns. It takes damage equal to 1/8 of its maximum HP at the end of each turn and cannot switch out.

lockedmove.description: The Pokémon is locked into a rampage for 2 to 3 turns. It repeats the same move each turn and becomes confused when the rampage ends.

mustrecharge.description: The Pokémon is recharging from a high-powered attack. It cannot act for the turn.

choicelock.description: The Pokémon is locked into a single move by its Choice item. It can only use that move until it switches out.

zpower.description: The Pokémon channels Z-Power from its held Z-Crystal. Its move is upgraded into a powerful Z-Move for the turn.

dynamax.description: The Pokémon is transformed into a giant form for 3 turns. Its maximum HP is boosted by 50% to 100%, and its moves become powerful Max Moves.

terastallization.description: The Pokémon is crystallized into its Tera Type. Its defensive typing becomes its Tera Type, and its same-type attack bonus (STAB) damage is enhanced for the remainder of the battle.

commanding.description: The Pokémon has entered the mouth of its ally. It boosts all of its ally's stats by 2 stages while becoming untargetable and unable to act.

commanded.description: The Pokémon has an ally in its mouth. All of its stats are boosted by 2 stages, but it cannot switch out.

gem.description: The Pokémon is powered by its held Gem. The power of its next move of the matching type is boosted by 30%, consuming the Gem.
